description: Best Buy Co., Inc. was incorporated in the state of Minnesota in 1966 and is driven by its purpose to enrich lives through technology and its vision to personalize and humanize technology solutions for every stage of life, accomplishing this by leveraging its combination of tech expertise and a human touch to meet customers' everyday needs whether they come to it online, visit its stores or invite it into their homes. It has operations in the U.S. and Canada through two reportable segments, Domestic and International, with the Domestic segment comprising its operations in all states, districts and territories of the U.S. along with its Best Buy Health business, and brand names including Best Buy, Best Buy Ads, Best Buy Business, Best Buy Essentials and Geek Squad.
